Thanks for taking the time to prepare a change.

Before submitting, please note:

- I am not accepting unsolicited external pull requests for this repository.
- The normal contribution path is an issue or discussion, not a new pull
  request. A diagnostic question is not a request for a pull request.
- PRs opened without prior maintainer direction may be closed without detailed
  review.

If you already have a tested patch or branch, link it as evidence in the existing
issue; see [Sharing a tested patch](https://github.com/rcourtman/Pulse/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#sharing-a-tested-patch).
Do not duplicate an existing report or publish private logs, configuration or
credentials. A patch is optional and does not guarantee acceptance.

For a PR already requested in an earlier conversation, retain that issue link
and the requested scope below. The maintainer owes it a reply and disposition
in this thread; do not recreate the PR or refile its evidence. Include the
source version, tests actually run and known limits. A source change or passing
test does not establish release availability.
